FAQ

Frequently asked questions for MagLock Wallet Pro With Adjustable Stand

How strong is the magnet in MAGLOCK wallet?

The MagLock and MagLock Pro wallets have strong magnetic power, ensuring that they stay securely attached to your phone.

Is the Capes MagLock wallet compatible with Android phones?

Yes, the Capes MagLock wallet is compatible with Android phones. Each Capes MagLock order comes with a universal magnetic ring that can be attached to any Android device, Non MagSafe case, making it universally compatible with any phone or case.

Is the Capes MagLock wallet compatible with MagSafe for iPhone?

Yes, the Capes MagLock wallet is compatible with iPhone 12 series, 13 series, 14 series, 15 series. Additionally, each Capes MagLock order comes with a universal magnetic ring that can be attached to any Non MagSafe case or iPhone 11, X and earlier models, making it universally compatible with any iPhone.

How many cards and cash can Capes MagLock wallet hold?

The Capes MagLock wallet can hold up to 3 cards or 2 cards plus cash. The Capes MagLock Pro can carry up to 7 cards or 5 cards plus cash.

How durable are the hinge and kickstand?

The hinge and kickstand of the Capes MagLock wallets are strong and have been rigorously tested in-house to ensure durability and reliability.

Does the wallet get dirty or show wear and tear over time?

The leather and carbon fiber finishes, coupled with premium stitching, ensure they maintain a high-quality, premium look as they develop character with use.

Will the Capes MagLock wallet fall off?

The magnetic strength of the MagLock wallet is very strong, ensuring that it stays securely attached to your phone and won't fall off.

Is the Capes MagLock wallet made from real leather?

No, the Capes MagLock wallet with a black leather finish is made from high-quality PU leather.

Are the cards easy to insert and remove?

Yes, the cards are easy to insert and remove. With the cutout at the front for easy access, you can effortlessly take your cards out without detaching the wallet.

Who should use the Capes MagLock Wallet?

Capes MagLock Wallets are perfect for those who prefer a slim profile over conventional bulky wallets. If you value sleek and minimalist design, the Capes MagLock Wallet is for you.
